blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
On the radio, directions must be short and clear. Four small words can move a big truck: turn, go, take, and follow.

"Turn right." "Turn left." "Go straight." These are imperatives. They start with the verb. You do not need a subject. You just say "Go left," and the driver goes.

Short sentences save time. A clear direction stops a wrong route. When you understand, you say "Copy that."

items.q: Why must radio directions be short?
options: To save time and stay clear
items.why: "Short sentences save time." Directions curtas economizam tempo e são claras.

items.q: How does an imperative sentence start?
items.why: "They start with the verb." Ex.: "Go left."

items.q: What do you say when you understand the direction?
items.why: "When you understand, you say 'Copy that.'"

items.q: The text suggests that a clear direction helps the driver…
options: stop the truck for the day
items.why: Inferência: "A clear direction stops a wrong route" — direção clara evita o caminho errado.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: you always need a subject in a command
simple words can move a big truck
long sentences are best on the radio
the driver should guess the way
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que quatro palavras pequenas movem um caminhão grande.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James dando direções a um motorista novo. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, this is James. Are you ready? Look at the map. I will help you.

First, go straight for two streets. Do not turn yet. Keep going. Good.

Now, at the corner, turn right. There is a big blue sign. Follow the signs to the highway.

Take the second exit. Not the first one, the second one. Then turn left.

The warehouse is on your right. It is a grey building. Park in front of the gate.

Please say "Copy that" when you understand. Drive slow. The route is easy. Call me if you are lost. Thank you.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What must the driver do first?
items.why: "First, go straight for two streets."

items.q: At the corner, the driver must…
items.why: "at the corner, turn right."

items.q: Which exit must the driver take?
items.why: "Take the second exit. Not the first one, the second one."

items.q: James says "Drive slow." This suggests he wants the driver to be…
items.why: Inferência: pedir para dirigir devagar mostra que ele quer cuidado e segurança.

items.q: Why does James say "Call me if you are lost"?
options: He wants to help if there is a problem
He does not know the way
items.why: Inferência: ele oferece ajuda caso o motorista se perca — quer que o trajeto dê certo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Follow this route to the port." A route is…
options: a way to go from one place to another
items.why: Route = rota, o caminho de um lugar a outro.

items.q: "Look at the map on the wall." A map shows…
items.why: Map = mapa, mostra ruas e lugares.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The warehouse is on this ___, next to the bank."
items.why: Street = rua. O prédio fica na rua, ao lado do banco.

items.q: "Turn at the corner." A corner is…
options: the place where two streets meet
items.why: Corner = esquina, onde duas ruas se encontram.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Take the ___ to drive fast between the two cities."
items.why: Highway = rodovia, para dirigir rápido entre cidades.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no rádio e no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Copy that — I will turn right at the corner." To say "copy that" means…
items.why: Copy that = entendi, confirmado (no rádio).

items.q: "Go straight for three streets." To go straight means to…
items.why: Go straight = seguir em frente.

items.q: "Follow the signs to the port." This means…
options: take a photo of the signs
read the signs and keep going that way
items.why: Follow the signs = seguir as placas para chegar ao destino.

items.q: "You went the wrong way. Please turn around." To turn around means to…
items.why: Turn around = dar meia-volta, ir no sentido contrário.

items.q: "Watch out for the truck on your left!" This means…
items.why: Watch out = cuidado, preste atenção ao perigo.
